articleTitle: Designing Roof Photovoltaic Systems in Municipal Buildings for Minimum Lighting Energy Costs
abstract: The report considers the optimal design of roof photovoltaic systems (PVS) for municipal buildings. PVSs reduce energy expenses by saving the costs of supply of power, which are a component of the total energy cost. The report addresses the question how big and what type of PVS should be selected when the energy produced by the PVS is guaranteed to be sold. Given known annual electricity needs for the building, a criterion for optimization of the inputs to the PVS is the minimum cost per unit of energy consumed (BGN/MWh), whether produced by the PVS or purchased by the system. The energy used can be either bought from the system or taken from batteries that store the energy produced by the PVS during the day. The optimal strategy is determined by the battery prices, the converters used (network or hybrid inverters) and by the 24-hour energy consumption schedule of the building's consumers.

articleTitle: Optimizing the Operating Modes of Roof Photovoltaic Systems on Public Premises
abstract: This report discusses optimal design and activities for efficient operation of roof photovoltaic systems (PVSs) on public premises. Based on annual group loading schedules for electricity consumers in municipal buildings, optimal operating modes of available PVSs are derived with the goal of balancing the consumption and storage modes of the generated on-the-spot electrical energy. A so-called "energy cooperative" serves as a mediator between the municipality and the electricity distribution company (EDC), which buys up the excess energy from the PVS during the day and delivers the necessary energy at night. Taking into account the amount of sunlight and the change of the energy consumption schedules for a 12-month period, a representative of the cooperative monitors the price of energy consumed by the municipal buildings by switching on and off buffer consumers or storing energy in rechargeable batteries.

articleTitle: Automated Recognition of Affect and Stress evoked by Audio-Visual stimuli
abstract: In the present work, we consider the automated detection of negative emotions and high-arousal negativevalence (HANV) states, which are akin to acute stress occurring in specific context. We investigate the influence and intricacy which subjective perception of negative emotions and acute stress brings to the process of automated recognition of these states. For that purpose we experimentally evaluate the advantages of modelling based on the person-independent tags of the audio-video stimuli, and models built with the personspecific self-reported tags. Based on the self-reported tags, which are obtained with only tiny extra effort, we report a relative improvement of the HANV detection accuracy with up to 5%.

articleTitle: Smart Lighting Solutions for Residences Using IoT Infrastructure: Advantages, Disadvantages and Effects on Energy Saving
abstract: Smart home systems have already become one of the most important applications of Internet of Things. Previously, the investment cost of smart home systems was quite expensive which required a lot of installation issues. However, wireless solutions offered by IoT applications has decreased the investment costs and brought easy, do it yourself solutions. In parallel to this, smart LED light sources and lighting control infrastructure have also been developed. In this study, it's aimed to investigate the latest technological developments in Internet of Things, smart LED lamps and control systems and application areas in residential lighting with regard to new communication protocols and standards. It is also aimed to investigate energy saving opportunities by smart LED lamps in comparison to incandescent lamps, CFLs and LEDs.

articleTitle: Measurement and Determination of the Unified Glare Rating of Indoor Lighting Systems
abstract: The paper presents a results of software calculation and experimental measurement determination of unified glare rating (UGR) for two teacher rooms in an educational building. Three-dimensional computer modeling and multivariate UGR software calculation with light-emitting diode luminaires having different lighting distributions and taking into account the actual position and the line of sight of the observer are performed. A methodology for experimental measurement and determination of UGR has been proposed and demonstrated for the same two rooms. The results are presented in tabular and graphical form. A comparative analysis of the results obtained from the software calculations and the experimental determination of UGR is carried out. Conclusions have been made about the influence on the accuracy of the URG values obtained of the light distribution type of the luminaires, the location and orientation of the line of sight of the observer, and the choice of the background luminance surface.

articleTitle: MM-SPEED: Multipath Multi-SPEED Routing Protocol in 6LoWPAN Networks
abstract: Internet of Things (IoT) is the future of the communication. The communication protocols and the IPv6 addressing adopted in IoT must be changed to meet the WSN requirements. IPv6 over Low power Wireless Personal Area Networks (6LoWPAN) is the standardized protocol for this type of adaption. In this paper the adaption of the MMSPEED routing algorithm in 6LoWPAN network has been presented and the experimental validation results have been shown as compared with SPEED and HiLoW protocols. Reliability and delivery ratio of the protocols in 6LoWPAN scenario are also given. The simulations have been done in NS-3.

articleTitle: Higher harmonics generated by LED retrofit lamps, depending on the used driver
abstract: The paper presents a study of the generated higher harmonics in the electrical power grid, obtained from the operation of retrofit LED light sources. More than 30 types of LED light sources of various manufacturers, widely marketed on the Bulgarian market, have been studied. It has been found that the resulting higher harmonics are mainly dependent on the type of the driver. In low-cost LED products, are used drivers, composed only of passive elements and without the use of filters for the generated harmonics. This results in serious harmonic distortions of the power grid parameters. Graphical dependency of the tested LED products is presented. Conclusions and recommendations have been made.

articleTitle: Investigation of Reliability of Diversity Systems Through Stress-Strength Model Analysis
abstract: Paper concerns a problem of reliability indexes calculation of two channel homogeneous and diversity system. Using SSM it is easy to determine the probability of Common Cause Failures (CCF) and other parameters of investigated redundant systems. Here is used a complex approach with Multi-Factor Stress-Strength Model (MFSSM). The obtained analytical formulas are verificated via simulation.

articleTitle: Some specifics of using LED drivers in dimming mode
abstract: Benefits of the dimmable LED luminaires are well known: energy savings due to avoiding non-permissible energy over consumption as result of the assumed maintenance factor (MF), which the designer uses to guarantee sufficient lighting of the respective object, with the assumption that the LED luminaries during their life span reduce their output; prolonged LEDs life due to less heat load during dimming; energy savings when applying the appropriate night lighting regime associated with changing the street light class. The paper presents the results of experiments with LED drivers, aimed to select appropriate levels of dimming. It has been observed, that with increased dimming "depth", the power factor is deteriorating and the financial sanction of the respective utility company may overreach the economic effect of the dimming. The "deep" diming may cause the LED drivers to generate harmonics. The harmonic content in the supply current may result in other equipment interference.

articleTitle: Color space distribution of luminaire for dynamic „tunable white" lighting at different color temperatures
abstract: In this paper are presented the experimental results from the study of light and color distributions of specially constructed luminaire for dynamic "tunable white" lighting. They would be the base for the following study in the field of lighting effects on human health and wellbeing-Human Centric Lighting (HCL).

articleTitle: Characterization of different types of photovoltaic cells using remote virtual system
abstract: In this paper, we present a remote lab for photovoltaic panel characterization and identification. The experimental system includes different photovoltaic panels connected to a virtual instrumentation and variable load. It allows students to obtain different characteristic curves. A survey has been conducted to find out how students evaluate the educational experience.

articleTitle: Reliability Investigation of TMR and DMR Systems with Global and Partial Reservation
abstract: In this article are considered three types system structures: TMR ("2-of-3"), "2-of-2" global reservation by replacing and "2-of-2" with partition reservation by replacing. Here are considered formulas for calculation of reliability the indices "System Availability" and "Mean Time Between Failures." On this basis here is conducted an analytical research of the reliability of the three systems. In conclusion, here is made a comparative analysis to determine which structure under what conditions is most reliable.

articleTitle: Mathematical modelling of micro and nanogrids with distributed generation
abstract: This article presents a Matlab- Simulink mathematical model of micro and nanogrids with distributed generation intended for power system stability studies. The model adequacy is estimated using a validation performed with a physical model of a representative microgrid with a hydraulic generator.The mathematical model offers admissible accuracy and could be successfully used for approximate power system stability, control and educational studies.Additionally, the model offers valuable opportunities for test evaluation of approaches and control strategies for smart active power management in micro and nanogrids under island and grid- connected mode.

articleTitle: Problems with the Use of LED Luminaries at Control Rooms
abstract: The physiological and psychological condition of the operators in control rooms is a very important factor due to the non-interruptible working process. Improper ergonomic conditions may lead to operator's fatigue. The lighting design is one of the most important ergonomic factors and it shall be always taken into account in design of control rooms. The recent tendencies for application of LED luminaires in all fields of lighting design have to be valued for this kind of working places. This paper represents recommendations for lighting design of electrical power facilities control rooms, based on modeling and measurement of the perceived radiation of operators in different visual situations and tasks. Conclusions are made based on the obtained results from the modeling and the experimental results.

Author Keywords: visual and non-visual aspects of lighting

articleTitle: Good Practices for Efficient Industrial Lighting
abstract: The paper presents the opportunities for realization of energy efficient industrial lighting. A real industrial plant is taken in consideration and comparison is made between the existing and designed lighting systems in terms of energy efficiency, estimated by means of Lighting Energy Numerical Indicator (LENI). The opportunity for maximum use of daylight is also considered and analyzed in details.

articleTitle: Transition from Luminance Curves to Curves of the Intensity for LED Luminaires
abstract: The following topics are dealt with: lighting; LED lamps; energy conservation; light sources; light emitting diodes; driver circuits; building integrated photovoltaics; street lighting; photometry; measurement uncertainty.

articleTitle: Intelligent Power Control for Lighting Applications
abstract: This paper presents analysis of concept for intelligent power management system for lightening applications supplied from renewable sources. The system is based on combination of high-efficient power supplies managed by microcontroller. Device is based on DC/DC power converters and the goal is to achieve maximum power efficiency and saving.

articleTitle: Renewable energy sources and lighting
abstract: Photovoltaic system is one of the promising renewable energy technologies. In this paper lighting system based on renewable energy sources is developed and analysed. The proposed system in the paper is designed to power lighting in common areas of residential buildings. A block diagram and system unites are presented in paper. Calculations of the costs have been presented.

articleTitle: Uncertainty Budget for Calibration of Luminance Meters for Measurement of Photopic Adaptation Luminance of Road Tunnels
abstract: The present paper represents uncertainty budget for calibration of luminance meters for road tunnels. There are several types of luminance meters calibrations which have different advantages and calibration setups. A description of the configuration for performance of calibrations of luminance meters used in TU Sofia is presented. The specific factors and their contribution in the mathematical model of the combined uncertainty for the used calibration method are observed. The calibration value is valid for the described measurement geometry and the proposed mathematical model. Conclusions are made for the different factors included in the uncertainty budget.

articleTitle: Algorithms for cloud segmentation with ground-based camera images
abstract: This paper deals with the detection and segmentation of clouds on high-dynamic -range (HDR) images of the sky as well as the calculation of the position of the sun at any time of the year. In order to predict the movement of clouds and the radiation of the sun for a short period of time, the clouds thickness and position have to be known as precisely as possible. Consequently, the segmentation algorithm has to provide satisfactory results regardless of different weather, illumination and climatic conditions. The principle of the segmentation is based on the classification of each pixel as a cloud or as a sky. This classification is usually based on threshold methods, since these are relatively fast to implement and show a low computational burden.

articleTitle: Modelling of Power Electronic Converter for LED Lighting System Powered by Micro and Nanogrid
abstract: This paper presents a power electronic converter for supplying a LED lighting system powered by micro and nanogrids. The proposed solution is intended for micro and/or nanogrids and consists of a battery, buck converter, control system and LED lighting system. A block diagram of the architecture of the studied system is presented. A MATLAB software environment is used for modelling of the proposed system. The main advantages and disadvantages are studied, presented and discussed.

articleTitle: Protection of lines supplying LED luminaries
abstract: The reliable operation of the lighting systems in great extent depends on the reliability of their power supply. The power supply reliability is related to the correct response of the respective protection devices assigned to provide trip commands in case of faults in the respective electric power distribution scheme. The designer's responsibility is to provide adequate settings of the feeder protections, which shall respond in case of overload, short circuit and ground faults. The settings shall have a sufficient safety margin of the normal load current and in particular of the "inrush current" which may occur in case of initial energizing of the protected equipment.

articleTitle: Optimal Control of Reactive Load in Road Tunnels
abstract: The sources of reactive power associated with tunnel lighting and supply system are studied in the paper. The variation of the power factor may due to variation of the load or to the operation of the one PV generator in case such is presented. It is shown that the sign of the reactive load can change in real time, changing from inductive to capacitive. The optimal compensation of the reactive loads with the help of inverter of the PV generator is discussed in details.

articleTitle: Uncertainties in Illuminance Meters Calibration
abstract: The paper concerns the uncertainties that appear when illuminance meters are undergoing calibration. All the possible uncertainty factors are described in details and analyzed. Their weight is estimated for both the direct and the comparative calibration methods.

articleTitle: Lighting in High Temperature Industrial Enviroment
abstract: The specifics of LED lighting in high temperature industrial environment is discussed in the paper. When industrial sites with very high ambient temperature (60 or even more degrees Celsius) have to be illuminated with LED luminaires, many features of LED lighting that are usually considered a priory true should be carefully studied. That influences the light flux, efficiency, reliability and price of LED lighting installation.

articleTitle: Comparison of Experimental and Simulation Data for Daylighting
abstract: The paper detailed information about experimental results, obtained for the Daylight Factor (DF) of an educational facility. The experimental data obtained is compared to computational results, given by different software products for lighting calculations. The correlation between the measured and the simulated data is estimated.

articleTitle: Study of the Electrical Characteristics of Light-Emitting Diode Luminaires at Amendment of the Supply Voltage
abstract: Results of the study of the change of electrical characteristics of light-emitting diode (LED) luminaires with different types of drivers and applications at amendment of the supply voltage are presented in the paper. Trends of the change in the electric current, real power, harmonic currents, total harmonic distortion and power factor for eleven LED luminaires with two type of drivers - pulse width modulation and bridge rectifier with capacitive divider, when varying the supply voltage are measured, analysed and presented in tabular, graphical and analytical form.

articleTitle: Particularities of photometric calculation and non-sinusoidal operation regime of luminaires with high pressure sodium vapour lamps
abstract: In the first part of this paper, the authors present an analysis from photometrical (technical lighting) point of view of a DELFIN 03 type luminaire used in the modern street lighting. For this it started from determining by calculation (using a numerical calculation method - the method of equal plane angles) of the total luminous flux emitted by the street luminaire (polar photometric curves are required - polar luminous intensity distribution in different planes) and of the efficiency. The distribution of illuminances to different montage heights was then analyzed. In the second part of the paper, is presented a comparative study of the harmonic (distorted) regime produced by these luminaires equipped with high pressure sodium vapour tubular lamps type HST E40 socket, 250 W, for a network of street public lighting. In this regard was used an own conception computation program, developed in the Mathcad programming environment completed with an Excel subprogram.ELECTROPUTERE S.A. CRAIOVA

articleTitle: Flicker experimental set up and visual perception of flicker
abstract: This paper talks about the measurements of luminous flux of different light sources and the production of an experimental set up for the purpose of observing light phenomena in LEDs. With the help of measurements, an insight on how luminous flux usually fluctuates in the various types of lamps was obtained. For easy observation and study of temporal light artefacts in LEDs, such as flicker and stroboscopic effect, an experimental set up with an option to adjust the supply voltage signal was constructed. At the end, we also show some of the results of the visual perception of flicker.

articleTitle: Dimmable electronic ballast for powerful compact fluorescent lamps
abstract: The developed electronic ballast (driver) is suitable for use in controllable combined indoor lighting systems and allows users to manually adjust illuminance levels (E) to their needs from both the general type lighting and the local type lighting in homes, public and office buildings.

articleTitle: Influence investigation of the illumination on the quality indicators of the signal security activity
abstract: The publication represents the thesis that illumination is one of the important but often underestimated factors for the achievement of high quality signal security activities (SSA), especially in the part related to the efficient operation of the Mobile Security Patrol (MSP). The speed of the MSP response, the possibilities of obtaining real information about the environment of the guarded object and the adequate counteraction of the intruders has been examined under the impact of the lightning. The risks of the process and the possibilities for its improvement at each step are examined and analyzed by applying a set of technical and organizational measures to ensure sufficient and reliable lightning. During the research is used simplified technology, that includes problems' visualization and the solutions are represented with a diagram and a table, which contributes to more clearly defined inconsistencies and corrective actions. The technology could be incorporated into the management systems of SSA as one of the means for improvement, according to the requirements of point 10 'Improvement', of management standards ISO 9001:2015, ISO 27001:2013, ISO 45001:2018 H ISO 18788:2015.

articleTitle: Optimized photovoltaic-energy storage system
abstract: The storage and optimization of the use of solar energy, which is only available in a limited time frame, requires monitoring and proper energy distribution. The use of two rechargeable groups, one with a smaller capacity and one with a much larger one, allows the charging to take place with less current and thus to reduce the cycles of the battery with the higher capacity. The system includes hardware for measuring energy stored in batteries and momentary generated by photovoltaic energy. With the help of the creation of an optimal energy plan and the possibility of calculating the savings by avoiding the need to purchase the relevant energy from the public network. The lead -acidic batteries and Li -ion batteries are combined for daily charging and discharging. The combination of two sets allows a relatively lower price for capacitance, while significantly increases the lifespan of the batteries.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of a Low-Cost Phasor Measurement Unit: A Comprehensive Review
abstract: The complexity of the contemporary electrical power systems imposes challenges in the aspect of monitoring, protection and control. In order to obtain a high speed of response, wide area effect and prices synchronisation, the grid control functions can be benefited by the implementation of Phasor Measurement Units (PMU). The paper is aimed to make a review of the commercial implementation of Phasor Measurement Units and then open source based implementations (open architecture hardware and software). This paper focuses on standard implementations; as a consequence, the concept of virtual PMU is not discussed here.

articleTitle: LIGHT POLLUTION AND ITS PRICE
abstract: Light and lighting are the civilization choice of people. The accessibility of lighting has created conditions for unlimited practical use during the dark period of the day. Those circumstances have led to the disturbance of the natural alternation of light and dark period. Hence, the night is becoming a day. Contemporary lighting systems belong to the group of technical systems that bring certain harmful effects on the external and internal environment, respectively on people and the living nature. One of them is the result of the well-known light pollution. The development of the contemporary light-based techniques and technologies, in addition to the unconditionally beneficial consequences, has led to the violation of the reasonable normal and socially acceptable limits by the scattering of the artificial light and especially the uncontrolled overlit areas. This is also a "scatter" of electrical energy.

Author Keywords: Average Annual Net Amount of Light
Directed and Reflected Light to the Sky

articleTitle: GMmQ. GENERALIZED METHODOLOGICAL MODEL OF THE QUALITY OF HIGHER EDUCATION
abstract: Light is life, a human necessity a priori. Light is a significant factor that directly affects productivity, quality of work, safety and health conditions. The reason is that visually people receive over 75% of the environmental information. The Harmonious Light Environment plays an important role in the economic and cultural development of society. The quality of higher education in the field of lighting technologies and lighting design has a national, European and global dimension. Important note in the recently approved Standards and Guidelines for Quality Assurance in the European Higher Education Area (ESG) is the centering of higher education towards students. The present work is motivated by the necessity of the development of a methodological model for quality of higher education with focus to the contemporary lighting design.
